realized_budget_check: Report actual new detail cells separately. Unequal realized areas prevent an equal-cell detail-quality interpretation even when proposed budgets match.
native_custody: Exact source/runtime identities, compiled recipe digest, original completed CyberNativeCellWorld acknowledgements and full uint16 little-endian material readback with SHA-256.

context_contract.structural_materials: Nonempty disjoint native material IDs used as actual structural hosts.
context_contract.detail_materials: Nonempty native material IDs used for detail; exclude protected-marker material.
context_contract.anchor_rects: Local x,y,w,h regions of allowed attachment faces. A support is counted only where actual structural material exists inside the rectangle.
context_contract.clearance_rects: Local x,y,w,h required empty regions. Initial and new/final intrusions reported separately.
context_contract.detail_zones: Local rect plus minimum_fraction and maximum_fraction for declared contextual detail density, fixed across matched arms.
context_contract.protection_rects: Local x,y,w,h protected cells; compare before versus after exactly.
context_contract.route: Optional two local cell coordinates for finite square-clearance BFS.

interpretation_limits: Hand-authored and deterministic-module equivalence is expected and does not establish model optimization.
Reference-guided and retrieval-guided arms are offline typed/procedural strategies, not model responses.
The six larger representative constructions are separate demonstrations, not extra independent comparative samples.
Context diagnostics are geometric proxies, not structural stress, native actor traversal, aesthetics or human preference.
No authorized model endpoint: zero model calls planned and no model-dependent conclusion.
No frozen GOLDMAPS training or evaluation split is changed.
